name: agience-server-nexus
description: Connects agents, services, and external systems by managing messaging delivery channels, webhooks, request routing, and remote execution.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email via an Authorizer artifact (Gmail API)

tools.name: notify_inbound
tools.description: Notify the operator about an inbound lead/artifact (contact form, newsletter subscribe, webhook, etc.)

tools.name: send_templated_email
tools.description: Send a templated transactional email driven by a triggering artifact (autoresponder, welcome, receipt, usage warning, etc.)

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message via a registered channel adapter (Telegram, Slack, email). The message is routed through the platform's channel infrastructure

tools.name: get_messages
tools.description: Poll a channel adapter for new messages since a given cursor. Returns message list sorted by time

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List registered channel adapters for the current user. Returns available channels and their connection status

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check the health and availability of a service endpoint. Returns status, latency, and any error details

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List registered service connections and their current status

tools.name: register_endpoint
tools.description: Register a service endpoint for routing. Registered endpoints can be targeted by route_request and proxy_tool

tools.name: route_request
tools.description: Route an HTTP request to a registered endpoint. Acts as a platform-aware proxy with auth injection

tools.name: proxy_tool
tools.description: Proxy an MCP tool call through a registered endpoint. Forwards the tool invocation to a remote MCP server and returns the result

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch content from a URL and return it inline. Useful for reading web pages, API responses, or any HTTP-accessible resource. Does NOT create an artifact — use create_artifact separately to persist

tools.name: ask_human
tools.description: Ask a question to the human operator

MANTLE_URI.description: Base URI of the Mantle backend

MCP_HOST.description: Bind host for the MCP server

MCP_PORT.description: HTTP port for the MCP server

_env_note: AGIENCE_API_URI and AGIENCE_API_KEY were declared required here and are read NOWHERE in server.py (verified 2026-07-31). A deployer honouring this manifest set two dead variables and omitted MANTLE_URI, which then silently defaulted to localhost:8081. This note lives at TOP LEVEL, not inside config.env — a consumer iterating env would otherwise see a variable named '_removed'.
_tools_note: Generated from the @mcp.tool registrations in server.py on 2026-07-31. It previously advertised tools that do not exist and omitted tools that do; a client reads this array to discover the surface.
